[Nominal C# checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-dotnet-20261012.md) add those Nat forms with .NET SDK 8.0.424 and shared framework 8.0.30, offline NuGet installation, relocated replay and source-free deployment on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal Java/Kotlin checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-jvm-20261013.md) add those Nat forms with JDK 22.0.2 and Kotlin 2.2.0, offline installation, relocated replay and source-free deployment of both consumers on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal native PHP checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-php-20261013.md) add those Nat forms with PHP 8.2.33 and Composer 2.5.5, offline installation and weak/strict replay before and after relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. Author/build roots are removed before installation; consumer PHP source remains required at runtime.
